purpose: Backward walk and two target-facing sidesteps for the Graybox Reach light enemy.

actions.walk_backward: 20 unique frames + loop endpoint; 15 Hz, 1.33s cycle
actions.strafe_left: 16 unique frames + loop endpoint; 15 Hz, 1.07s cycle
actions.strafe_right: 16 unique frames + loop endpoint; 15 Hz, 1.07s cycle

poses: Collected stance and double support at entry for the sidesteps.
Leading foot reaches outward while the trailing foot supports; trailing foot follows without crossing.
Torso remains aimed toward the target, retaining v5 torso twist and separate cannon/claw inertia.
Retreat uses low backward steps, with soft knees and a forward-looking head.
editing: Each .blend contains the 22-bone rig, original mesh weights, packed texture and one looping action. Save manual edits before regeneration. Regeneration replaces these snapshots. Export then copy the PSXA into assets/animations/light_directional_v1.
calibration: The light enemy walk speed cooks to 2 units/tick; spacing_speed_percent=50 selects 1 unit/tick for circling and retreat. Clips run at 15 Hz with the same poses/strides. Source model scale113 and instance scale417 produce Q12 184; cooking divides positions by16. The distance-driven gait clock uses this spacing speed as its nominal rate.
limits: Contact checks assume straight constant-speed movement. Orbit rotation, radius correction and collisions can still introduce foot slip.
